## Validation

List the checks performed and their results. State anything not tested and why.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change matches current scope and preserves requirement IDs and priorities.
- [ ] Relevant documentation is consistent, uses British English and contains no em dash characters.
- [ ] Validation evidence and implementation limitations are stated accurately.
- [ ] No secrets, private records or unrelated changes are included.
- [ ] Any intentional baseline changes follow the Decision Log process; historical sources are preserved.

## Limitations or follow-up

Note remaining work, risks or decisions needed, or write none.
